days.theme: Arrival · Sanno Matsuri choir · Harry Potter Akasaka · Check-in · Gyoen · Central Park hydrangeas · Observation deck · Konbini night

slots.title: Land Haneda
slots.description: Immigration, bags, Suica IC cards — all at the airport. Allow 60–75 min. Target exit by 9am.
slots.nav: Follow Arrivals signs · Suica machines at ticket gates · Search 'Haneda Airport Terminal 3'
tips: Suica card before exit

slots.title: Limousine bus → Shinjuku · drop bags
slots.description: Direct to hotel, luggage underneath, no transfers. ~75 min. Drop bags at hotel reception — can't check in until 2–3pm.
slots.nav: Airport Limousine counter at Arrivals · Ask for 'Basta Shinjuku' stop · Hotel is 10 min walk east from Basta Shinjuku
tips: Drop bags at hotel on arrival — check-in not until 2-3pm

slots.title: Breakfast — Shinjuku kissaten
slots.description: Old-school Japanese coffee shop near the hotel. Sit, eat, decompress. Morning set (toast, egg, coffee).
slots.nav: Walk from hotel · Search 'kissaten Shinjuku' or ask hotel staff

slots.title: Metro to Akasaka
slots.description: Head to Akasaka for Sanno Matsuri. Start with Harry Potter station, then walk to the torii tunnel base.
slots.nav: Metro Marunouchi line from Shinjuku-sanchome → Akasaka-mitsuke (8 min) · Transfer Chiyoda line one stop → Akasaka Station, Exit 2 · Search "Akasaka Station Tokyo"

slots.title: Harry Potter — Akasaka Station
slots.description: 5 min walk from Akasaka Station. Station fully themed — floating candles, moving portraits, HP music. Giant time turner photo op at Exit 3a. 20–30 min. Then walk around to the torii tunnel entrance.
slots.nav: Already at Akasaka Station · Exit 3a · Search "Akasaka Station Tokyo Harry Potter" · After HP wander, walk 5 min to torii tunnel base at Exit 2 side

slots.title: Hie Shrine — tea ceremony + sweets
slots.description: Sanno Matsuri active Jun 7–17. Traditional Japanese sweets and Sayama tea served all day in shrine precincts. Tunnel of red torii gates. Wander the grounds before the choir starts.
slots.nav: From Akasaka Station Exit 2, walk 5 min to torii tunnel base · Climb up through ~90 red torii gates (stairs) · Reach shrine grounds at the top · Tea ceremony in shrine precincts · Search "Hie Shrine Torii Tunnel Tokyo"
tips: Enter via torii tunnel stairs from Akasaka side · one-way loop · escalator down the other side after choir

slots.title: Choir concert — Songs of Japan
slots.description: Akasaka Hikawa Choir performs in the lower worship hall (下拝殿). 45 min. Jun 8 only. Ancient shrine + live Japanese choral music + festival atmosphere.
slots.nav: At Hie Shrine main grounds · Lower worship hall (下拝殿) · Signposted within shrine · Jun 8 only at 12:15pm
tips: Jun 8 only — this is a one-time event

slots.title: Back to Shinjuku — hotel check-in
slots.description: Descend via outdoor escalator on the Tameike-Sanno side. Head back for the 2–3pm check-in window. Showers, rest, regroup.
slots.nav: After choir, take outdoor escalator down from shrine · Walk 5 min to Tameike-Sanno Station · Ginza/Namboku line → transfer to Marunouchi → Shinjuku-sanchome · ~15 min · Walk to hotel
tips: 2–3pm check-in

slots.title: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
slots.description: ¥500 entry. Huge, peaceful, lots of benches. Perfect for jet-lagged wandering. Allow 60–75 min. Closes 6pm in June (last entry 5:30pm).
slots.nav: JR Shinjuku South Exit, 10 min walk · OR Metro Marunouchi → Shinjuku-Gyoenmae, Exit 2, 5 min walk · Search 'Shinjuku Gyoen'
tips: ¥500 entry · closes 6pm in June · last entry 5:30pm

slots.title: Shinjuku Central Park — Hydrangea Road
slots.description: 2–3 min walk from Tokyo Metropolitan Building. Peak June bloom — blue, purple, white, pink hydrangeas. Free, 20–30 min.
slots.nav: Walk 2-3 min west from Shinjuku Gyoen toward Shinjuku Station West Exit direction · Or walk directly from hotel · Search 'Shinjuku Central Park Tokyo'

slots.title: Free observation deck — 45th floor
slots.description: 202m up, free. Views of Skytree, Tokyo Tower, Meiji Shrine, Fuji on clear days. Sunset ~7pm. North tower slightly less crowded.
slots.nav: 2-3 min walk from Shinjuku Central Park · OR Oedo line → Tochomae (basement of building) · Search 'Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building' · North tower entrance
tips: Go up by 5pm to beat the queue · North tower slightly less crowded

slots.title: Projection mapping show — Citizens' Square
slots.description: Free show every 30 min from 7:30pm on the twin towers. Watch from grassy plaza outside the building.
slots.nav: Stay at Metropolitan Building · Citizens' Square is the grassy area in front of the towers · Show starts 7:30pm
tips: Show starts 7:30pm · every 30 min

slots.title: Konbini dinner — first konbini experience
slots.description: 7-Eleven or FamilyMart near hotel. Everyone grabs their own — onigiri, bento, karaage, edamame, inari sushi, drinks, dessert. Eat in the rooms. Early night — jet lag wins tonight.
slots.nav: Walk back to hotel area · Search '7-Eleven Shinjuku' · Open 24hrs
tips: Must-try: egg salad sandwich, onigiri, chicken karaage, inari sushi

days.rain_plan: Largely rain-resilient. Hie Shrine choir is indoors (lower worship hall). Observation deck fully indoor. Gyoen and Central Park fine with umbrellas. Konbini always indoors. Just bring umbrellas.

days.theme: Meiji · Harry Potter Harajuku · Takeshita · Shibuya · Nakameguro · Ghibli Clock · teamLab Planets

slots.title: Meiji Shrine
slots.description: Forested walk, torii gate, quiet before crowds. Sake + wine barrels. Allow 45 min. Exit via the Omotesando Gate (south side) — Harry Potter store and Takeshita Street are a 5-min walk.
slots.nav: JR Yamanote → Harajuku Station, Omotesando Exit (south side) · 1-2 min walk to main torii gate · Search 'Meiji Jingu Shrine Tokyo'
tips: Go early — crowds from 10am · Use Omotesando Exit not the forest side

slots.title: Breakfast — Harajuku
slots.description: Café Mori no Terrace at the Yoyogi Park entrance. Or Takeshita Street crepes.
slots.nav: 5 min walk from Meiji south gate toward Takeshita Street · Search 'Cafe Mori no Terrace Harajuku'

slots.title: Harry Potter Flagship Store — Harajuku
slots.description: Japan's first HP flagship, opened 2025. Right at Meiji-Jingumae Station — zero detour between Meiji and Takeshita. Japan-only exclusives. 20–30 min.
slots.nav: 3 min walk from Meiji south gate · Near Meiji-Jingumae Station on Omotesando-dori · Search 'Harry Potter Store Harajuku Tokyo'
tips: Japan-only exclusive items

slots.title: Takeshita Street wander
slots.description: Pedestrian-only, very colourful, 30 min. Cat Street runs parallel toward Shibuya — quieter, good boutiques, 20-min walk to the scramble.
slots.nav: Walk from HP store · Takeshita-dori directly behind Harajuku Station · Search 'Takeshita Street Harajuku'

slots.title: Shibuya scramble crossing
slots.description: Watch from street level, then Mag's Park rooftop for aerial shot (free). Hachiko statue right outside.
slots.nav: Walk 15 min down Cat Street from Takeshita · OR JR Yamanote → Shibuya, Hachiko Exit · Search 'Shibuya Scramble Crossing'

slots.title: Lunch — Shibuya food halls
slots.description: Basement of Hikarie or Scramble Square. Huge variety, vegetarian options labelled, picky eaters sorted.
slots.nav: Scramble Square: connected to Shibuya Station · Hikarie: 3 min walk east · Search 'Shibuya Scramble Square' · Food halls in B2

slots.title: Daikanyama + Nakameguro canal walk
slots.description: 15 min walk south. T-Site bookshop is genuinely beautiful. Drift along the Meguro River. Allow 90 min.
slots.nav: Walk 15 min south from Shibuya · OR Tokyu Toyoko → Daikanyama Station · Search 'T-Site Daikanyama' then walk Meguro River toward Nakameguro

slots.title: Travel to Shiodome — Ghibli Clock
slots.description: Get to 2nd floor walkway before 3pm.
slots.nav: From Nakameguro: Hibiya line → Kasumigaseki, transfer Toei Oedo → Shiodome · ~25 min · OR Hibiya line → Shimbashi, walk 5 min · Search 'Nippon TV Building Shiodome'

slots.title: Ghibli Clock — Ni-Tele Building
slots.description: Designed by Miyazaki. Show just before 3pm — be at 2nd floor outside by 2:55. ~5 min. Free.
slots.nav: Shiodome Station, Exit 8 or Shimbashi walk · Search 'Ni-Tele Clock Shiodome' · 2nd floor outdoor walkway of Nippon TV building
tips: Arrive 2:55pm · 2nd floor walkway · show runs just before 3pm

location.name: Ni-Tele Really Big Clock Shiodome Tokyo

slots.title: Hamarikyu Gardens — optional
slots.description: 5 min walk from Shiodome. Traditional garden, tea house, ¥300. Good quiet sit before teamLab. Skip if energy is low.
slots.nav: 5 min walk south from Shiodome · Search 'Hamarikyu Gardens Tokyo' · ¥300 entry

slots.title: Yurikamome line → Shin-Toyosu
slots.description: Shimbashi → Shin-Toyosu on the elevated Yurikamome line. ~25 min. Runs over Rainbow Bridge and Tokyo Bay. Sit left side facing Toyosu.
slots.nav: Walk 5 min from Shiodome to Shimbashi Station · Yurikamome line platform · Ride to Shin-Toyosu Station · Sit left side for bay views
tips: Sit left side — Rainbow Bridge and bay views

slots.title: Ramen at teamLab Planets
slots.description: Vegan Ramen UZU on-site — Michelin Green Star restaurant. This is dinner — arrive hungry. 30 min before entry. Plant-based menu, good for vegetarians.
slots.nav: Shin-Toyosu Station · 10 min walk · Search 'teamLab Planets Tokyo' · Restaurant at entrance area
tips: This is dinner — arrive hungry · Vegan Ramen UZU is Michelin Green Star

slots.title: teamLab Planets — entry
slots.description: 90 min inside. Wear rollable trousers — some rooms have water. Lockers provided. No bags in most rooms. Phones allowed.
slots.nav: Already at venue · Shin-Toyosu Station, 10 min walk · Search 'teamLab Planets Tokyo DMM'
tips: Booked 6:30pm · wear rollable trousers · socks will get wet · bring a bag for wet items

slots.title: Head back to Shinjuku
slots.description: Yurikamome to Shimbashi, JR Yamanote to Shinjuku. ~40 min.
slots.nav: Reverse Yurikamome: Shin-Toyosu → Shimbashi · JR Yamanote → Shinjuku · ~40 min total

days.rain_plan: If heavy rain: skip Meiji/Shibuya/Nakameguro. Tokyo National Museum in Ueno instead (fully indoor, 3–4 hrs). Then Akihabara afternoon. teamLab evening unaffected. Search 'Tokyo National Museum Ueno' — JR Yamanote → Ueno, Park Exit, 10 min walk.

days.theme: Old Tokyo — Asakusa · Fukagawa Goma · Yanaka · Akihabara · Kanda Myojin · Omoide Yokocho · last night

slots.title: Pack Kyoto bags · drop at reception
slots.description: Pack all Kyoto bags before leaving. Drop at hotel reception — Yamato Takuhaibin collects by 10am. Keep a day pack only: change of clothes for Hakone day and Kyoto night 1, toiletries, documents. Bags delivered to Kyoto hotel Jun 12.
slots.nav: At hotel · ask front desk to arrange Takuhaibin forwarding to Kyoto hotel if not already done · ~¥1,500 per bag
tips: Drop at reception before 10am · keep day pack only · bags arrive Kyoto Jun 12

slots.title: Senso-ji Temple — Asakusa
slots.description: Tokyo's oldest temple. Go before 8:30 — tour groups from 9am. Kaminarimon gate, Nakamise Dori shopping street, draw an omikuji fortune. Allow 45 min.
slots.nav: Metro Ginza line → Asakusa Station, Exit 1 · 5 min walk · Kaminarimon Gate directly ahead · Search 'Senso-ji Temple Asakusa'
tips: Go early — very crowded by 9am · covered Nakamise street is rain-friendly

slots.title: Breakfast — Asakusa
slots.description: Old-school kissaten near the temple. Or ningyo-yaki cake snacks from the Nakamise stalls while walking.
slots.nav: Walk from Senso-ji · Search 'kissaten Asakusa' or grab ningyo-yaki from Nakamise stalls

slots.title: Asakusa side streets
slots.description: Denpoin-dori for craft shops, pottery, Japanese knives. Slower and more local than Nakamise.
slots.nav: Walk from Senso-ji main hall · Denpoin-dori runs parallel to Nakamise on the west side · Search 'Denpoin-dori Asakusa'

slots.title: Travel to Monzen-Nakacho
slots.description: Metro to Fukagawa Fudo-do for the 11am Goma ritual.
slots.nav: Metro Ginza line from Asakusa → Nihombashi (14 min) · Transfer to Tozai line → Monzen-Nakacho, Exit 1 · ~20 min total · Search 'Monzen-Nakacho Station'

slots.title: Fukagawa Fudo-do — Goma fire ritual
slots.description: 11am ceremony. Remove shoes, enter main hall. Fire, taiko drums, monks chanting 45 min. Unlike anything else on this trip. No photography whatsoever during the ritual.
slots.nav: Monzen-Nakacho, Exit 1 · Ninjo Fukagawa Goriyaku-dori approach road immediately visible — 150m path along Eitai-dori leads directly to temple · 2 min walk · Search 'Fukagawa Fudo-do Temple'
tips: 11am sharp · no photography · fully indoor

slots.title: Tomioka Hachimangu Shrine
slots.description: Right next door to Fukagawa Fudo-do. Historic, much less visited. Food stalls on Ninjo Fukagawa Goriyaku Dori.
slots.nav: 1 min walk from Fukagawa Fudo-do · Search 'Tomioka Hachimangu Shrine Tokyo'

slots.title: Lunch — Monzen-Nakacho or Kiyosumi-Shirakawa
slots.description: Good local izakayas in Monzen-Nakacho. Or 10 min walk to Kiyosumi-Shirakawa — Tokyo's specialty coffee neighbourhood.
slots.nav: Near Exit 1 for izakayas · OR walk 10 min west · Search 'Kiyosumi-Shirakawa cafe Tokyo'

slots.title: Travel to Yanaka
slots.description: To Nippori for Yanaka Ginza. Option: transfer to Chiyoda line at Otemachi for Sendagi Station — flatter approach.
slots.nav: Option A (stairs): Metro Tozai → Nihombashi, JR Yamanote → Nippori, West Exit · ~25 min · Option B (flat): Tozai → Otemachi, Chiyoda line → Sendagi, Exit 2 · ~25 min · Search 'Yanaka Ginza'

slots.title: Yanaka Ginza
slots.description: 1950s local shopping street. Cat statues, indie shops, snacks. Walk to Yuyake Dandan (Sunset Stairs) for the neighbourhood view. Feels pre-war Tokyo.
slots.nav: From Nippori West Exit: turn left, follow slope up, take right fork · ~5 min walk to top of Yuyake Dandan stairs · From Sendagi Exit 2: walk 3 min east, flat approach · Search 'Yanaka Ginza Tokyo'

slots.title: Travel to Akihabara
slots.description: JR Yamanote one stop south from Nippori.
slots.nav: JR Yamanote from Nippori → Akihabara Station · ~10 min · Electric Town Exit (east side)

slots.title: Akihabara
slots.description: Let the teenagers lead. Super Potato for retro gaming, Yodobashi Camera (7 floors), Don Quijote. Comes alive after dark.
slots.nav: Electric Town Exit · Super Potato: search 'Super Potato Akihabara' · Yodobashi: outside station · Don Quijote: search 'Don Quijote Akihabara'

slots.title: Kanda Myojin — chinowa purification ring
slots.description: 7 min walk from Akihabara. Giant cogon grass ring set up all June — walk through it to cleanse the first half of the year. Free, 10 min, genuinely special Shinto ritual.
slots.nav: Akihabara Electric Town Exit · Walk north 7 min uphill · OR JR Chuo line → Ochanomizu, 5 min walk · Search '神田明神' or 'Kanda Myojin Shrine' · Chinowa ring in main courtyard · Open 24hrs
tips: 7 min walk north from Electric Town Exit · closer to Ochanomizu Station

location.name: 神田明神 Kanda Myojin Shrine Tokyo

slots.title: Dinner — Akihabara or Shinjuku
slots.description: Stay in Akihabara for ramen or izakaya, or head back to Shinjuku. Vegetarian-friendly in both areas.
slots.nav: Stay in Akihabara · OR JR Yamanote → Shinjuku ~15 min · Search 'vegetarian ramen Akihabara' or 'izakaya Shinjuku'

slots.title: Omoide Yokocho — last Tokyo wander
slots.description: Memory Lane in Shinjuku — tiny izakayas, smoke, paper lanterns. No cover charge, just walk through. Right next to Shinjuku Station west exit.
slots.nav: JR Shinjuku Station West Exit · Immediately to the left · Search 'Omoide Yokocho Shinjuku' · Free to walk through

slots.title: Hotel — early night
slots.description: Early night — Romancecar tomorrow morning from Shinjuku.
slots.nav: At hotel · Ask front desk for Takuhaibin forwarding to Kyoto hotel · ~¥1,500 per bag · Bags delivered to Kyoto hotel Jun 12
tips: Early night — Romancecar departs Shinjuku ~8:30am tomorrow

days.rain_plan: Mostly rain-resilient. Senso-ji has covered Nakamise walkways. Fukagawa Goma fully indoor. Akihabara largely indoor. Kanda Myojin has covered corridors. Yanaka weak spot — swap for Kappabashi Kitchen Street if heavy rain (covered arcades, between Asakusa and Akihabara). Search 'Kappabashi Kitchen Street Tokyo'.
days.notes: Takuhaibin: drop bags at reception before 10am this morning. Yamato collects during the day, delivers to Kyoto hotel Jun 12. Day pack contents: change of clothes for Hakone + Kyoto night 1, toiletries, documents, Romancecar tickets.

practical.hotel: ACT ONE Japan, 6-11-11 Shinjuku, Shinjuku-ku · Nearest station: Shinjuku-sanchome · 10 min walk from JR Shinjuku Station east exit
practical.transport: Suica IC card: load at Haneda on arrival, taps in/out on all trains, buses, taxis, and convenience stores. Google Maps Transit mode gives exact lines, platforms, walking directions.
practical.food_vegetarians: Say 'bejitarian desu' or show a dietary card. Vegan Ramen UZU at teamLab is plant-based. Shibuya food halls clearly labelled. Konbini: inari sushi, edamame, tamago onigiri.
practical.food_konbini: 7-Eleven is best. Must-try: egg salad sandwich, onigiri, chicken karaage, tamagoyaki, nikuman (pork bun). Inari sushi is vegetarian. Hot drinks at register machine.
practical.cash: Withdraw yen at 7-Eleven ATMs — accept foreign cards reliably. Have cash for shrine entry fees, street food, small restaurants.
practical.weather: Rainy season in June — some rain likely. Carry small umbrellas. 22–28°C, high humidity. Rain plans provided for each day.
practical.festival: Sanno Matsuri active Jun 7–17 at Hie Shrine, Akasaka. Jun 8 choir concert at 12:15pm in lower worship hall (下拝殿). Tea ceremony and sweets all day. Free. Metro Marunouchi → Akasaka-mitsuke, 8 min walk.
practical.takuhaibin: Forward bags from Tokyo hotel to Kyoto on evening of Jun 10. ~¥1,500 per bag, next-day delivery. Arrange at hotel front desk. Travel light through Hakone on Jun 11.
